evidence: Converts a screen rect to tile coords via Map_ScreenToTileCoords/Map_RecordPointToGridCell, then height-adjusts start/end cells with Grid_GetCell and emits a row-flip flag.
Sets byte +0x2e of the 0xc-stride cell record selected by index and redraws it through UI_DrawObjectWithBounds when the value changes.
Sets global mode DAT_0057c5c0 to 3 (5 when mission flag DAT_0057bb20 is set) and queues child command -0x18684, whose handler shows the end-of-stage message.
Compiler thunk of Stats_ComputeAverageGroupScore (0x479db0): buckets record +0xc values by city group, averages each bucket and rounds.
Draws one character through Font_DrawGlyphClipped using glyph tables at +0x460 and advances pen +0x9a0; CR/LF reset x and add line height +0x9b0.
Under game lock +0x240 iterates the +0x1500 object map and calls UI_SetChildScale(record, rating multiplier * Rating_AdjustA).
Sums Stats_GetGroupScore over the player's +0x148 subrecord map (count +0x15c), or evaluates the supplied record when param_4 is set.
Frees every value of seven ID maps (+4,+8,+0xc,+0x10,+0x14,+0x28,+0x2c) in the global cache object using type-specific destructors.
Hit-tests the child under the mouse, tracks hover enter/leave with timeGetTime, invokes the child vtable method and queues command 0xc/0xd.
Maps weapon-profile page id 0..0x1d to Sound_ProcessEvent event ids (0x1d..0x22) or Sound_PlayEffectByIndex while honoring the variant flag.
Finds/creates the 0x28-stride record at the given offset and adds reciprocal 8-slot neighbor keys to the previous record via the Object_* helpers.
Under CS 0x5842a0 snapshots a 0x48 record, calls Record_AdvanceFrameSequence, returns the old/new position pairs and restores the record so the advance is only evaluated.
Collects +0x16f8 records with player byte 1, owner +0x10<1 and +0xc>0 that have an occupied neighbor, picks one at random and optionally assigns owner +0x164.
Counts which of the 0x55 per-action counters at plan+0x68 are nonzero across map +0x110, quicksorts 86 id/count pairs and returns the two most frequent ids.
Maps statistic-page index 0..0xc to Sound_PlaySfxByIndex effects (0x14..0x16, 0x1c variants, 0x1d..0x1f) when sound is enabled.
Lazily allocates the 0x11c-byte window at +0x34 via Window_Construct and configures its surface from the owner surface with Surface_ConfigureFromOwner.
Averages the best (field+4,field+8) pair match percentage for record types 1 and 2 and stores the clamped result at +0x1850.
Returns the maximum Stats_GetGroupScore over the 7 categories for each day index up to the game-day count (capped at 100).
Computes the percentage of records with byte +0xc==3 among type 1..4 record counts plus those records and stores the clamped value at +0x1868.
Builds a solid-color style record and draws the four rectangle edges with UI_DrawLine from param_1/param_2 to param_3/param_4.
Increments +0x187c and applies a 5 percent object-value change on the first call and 1 percent on later calls through Game_AdjustPlayerObjectPercent.
Removes the ten profile/stat UI keys 0x1f61-0x1f67, 0x433, 0x439 and 0x43a via UI_RemoveObjectByKey.
Fills global index array DAT_0057ca94 with 0..n-1 and quicksorts it with the comparator used in weighted-stat ranking mode.
Aligns a cell sprite to the record rect with UI_AlignSpriteToRect and blits it through Surface_BlitRLEEnsureFormat.
Sets company row +0x54 to game-date field +0xc plus the offset and pushes a type-1 recent-entry record.
Repeatedly draws a random 0x28-stride record via Array_GetRandomRecord28B until its byte +6 is nonzero.
Quicksorts the global company index array DAT_0057cc40 with the alternate ranking comparator selected by DAT_00568bdc.
Computes a new value from the drag point and +0x94, clamps it to the current min/max slot, stores it via UI_SetClampedValue and queues command 0x19.
Adds the signed delta +0xd0 to value slot 0, stores it via UI_SetClampedValue and queues commands 0x1a/0x19/0x18 when the value changes.
Scalar deleting destructor: calls SoundBuffer_DestroyInterfaces (0x541660) and Mem_Free when the low delete flag is set.
